claimedSlice: opencv2/cudastereo.hpp parser-backed CUDA stereo-correspondence public declarations plus the pinned module CMake build/dependency contract
limitation: The map records parser identities and exact CudaStereo wrapper evidence; it does not claim repository-wide contrib parity or external module availability.
externalDataDependencies: The cudastereo module is disabled unless the OpenCV build enables CUDA or CUDA stubs and is unavailable on iOS/WinRT; real stereo execution depends on an external CUDA toolkit/runtime.

The module requires opencv_geometry and opencv_stereo and optionally opencv_cudev; GpuMat/Stream, asynchronous disparity transport, and belief-propagation/SGM state are outside this package. No CUDA stereo wrapper/runtime is bundled.

declarations.reason: Enum and class declarations are retained as parser metadata; callable evidence is classified independently.

The CUDA stereo-correspondence surface in cv::cuda has no native CudaStereo wrapper entrypoint or managed public owner in the current package; OpenCV disables the module on iOS/WinRT and unless CUDA or CUDA stubs are enabled, while disparity execution requires an external CUDA toolkit/runtime and the upstream geometry/stereo dependency chain. GpuMat/Stream ownership, asynchronous execution, disparity output representation, and parameter-rich BP/SGM algorithm state remain outside the current ABI/API and deterministic smoke contract.
